prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: Children choosing colorful dresses, skirts and ribbons in a friendly dress-up room. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Dress and Color". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Dress and skirt, ribbon and ring.
Pick the style for the spring.
Black and brown, green and gold.
Pretty color, bright, not old.
Choose the size, short and long.
Feel like you and sing the song.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
